name: Herald
author: Kshitij Bohara
description: Fast keyboard-first RSS and Hacker News reader with a daily digest

barWidget.description: Headlines from your feeds and Hacker News

schema.label: Feeds
schema.description: One source per line: an RSS/Atom/JSON feed URL, or hn:top, hn:best, hn:new, hn:ask, hn:show, hn:jobs with an optional :count suffix.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often feeds are fetched in the background. Minimum 2.

schema.label: Headline rotation (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar pill cycles to the next headline. 0 disables rotation.

schema.label: Stories per HN feed
schema.description: How many stories to fetch for each hn: source.

schema.label: Items per RSS feed
schema.description: How many recent items to keep from each RSS/Atom feed.

schema.label: Daily digest time
schema.description: 24-hour HH:MM for the morning briefing notification. Empty disables it.

schema.label: AI summaries
schema.description: Show a Summarize action that pipes article text to your local AI command. Off by default; article text never leaves your machine unless you enable it.

schema.label: AI command
schema.description: Shell command that reads article text on stdin and prints a short summary, e.g. ollama run llama3.1.

schema.label: Show scores
schema.description: Show HN points and comment counts beside each story.
